elec_earthing.definition: The whole arrangement that connects the metal parts of an installation to the earth, so that a fault current has a safe way back.
elec_earthing.example: The earthing of the pump was checked when the board was replaced.

machine_learning.definition: The method of letting a system find patterns in data instead of following instructions a person wrote for every case.
machine_learning.example: Spam filtering was one of the first everyday uses of machine learning.

may_i.definition: A careful, grown-up way to ask for something. People listen more when you use it.

systems_thinking.definition: Reasoning about how the parts of a system affect each other, including effects that appear far away in time or structure.

try_first.definition: To make a small attempt before you ask for help.
try_first.example: I tried first, and then I asked.
